H3 (eval-path buffer feed defect) is REFUTED (divergence median strictly positive); H1 (agent frozen) is constrained (n_inband_ticks mod 119 = 7/22/114, hazards static).

Fourth candidate cause, recorded but unremarked in the run: E3 fired on 2380 of 2400 steps (n_latched 20) against a configured e3_steps_per_tick=10 (MECH-093 arousal-scaled rate is the candidate mechanism). The cross-rate regime never occurred, and the ~1300 in-band ticks per seed are adjacent-step pseudo-replicates (pooled arf_shallow 0.477).

Remaining live causes: H2 z_world temporal under-differentiation (v3 observation->z_world binding constraint) and H4 E3-rate collapse. One recording probe discriminates them (z_world step delta, encoded z0 norm, e3 tick period trace, position trace) -- no fan-out portfolio needed.

C1: pooled +0.076 passes the margin but 2/3 seeds positive (seed 0 -0.174; its warm-up hazard_survival_gate FAILED, hazard_median_last_window 8.5, yet scored green; arf 0.449->0.275, below chance). Curves non-monotone: seed 2 D=20 dip 0.395 then D=30 0.768; seed 1 lift already at D=10 (+0.165), so the D>=20-only/drift reading holds for seeds 0 and 2 only.

Readiness gap: no warm-up-survival precondition; rolled z_world norm ceiling 1e6 is non-binding (observed 24-145), so drift cannot be separated from integration. Recording gap: z_world step delta, z0 norm, e3 tick period and position trace existed at run time but were not recorded.
